display_name: Landlord and Tenant Act 1985 (UK) under one top-level goal — the s 11 repairing and s 9A fitness covenants and when the latter bites, service charges payable after ss 19, 20 and 20B with s 21B withholding, and the deadlines for landlord information (ss 1, 3, 22) — and those three goals

others: the first day the fitness covenant bites for (lta-repair.l4)
the payable part of … in a demand served on (lta-service-charges.l4)
the tenant may withhold payment of (lta-service-charges.l4)
the last day to disclose the landlord's identity after a request received on (lta-information.l4)
the last day for notice of an assignment on … with next rent day (lta-information.l4)
the end of the old landlord's liability under (lta-information.l4)

scope: Goal-focused, at the user's direction: ss 1(1), 3(1), (3A)-(3B), 9A(1), 9B, 11(1), 13, 14, 19(1), 20(1), (7), 20B, 21B, 22(2), (4) of the revised text as at 29 June 2026. Inputs: lease dates and categories, reasonable costs, consultation and appropriate amounts, request, assignment and notice dates, the s 9A commencement date. Left out on purpose: rent books, fitness in Wales, social housing hazards, building safety, service charge information regulations, insurance, tenants' associations.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-18 (tests-independent.l4, 114 assertions from expectations written before the encoding was read); one failed (s 9B(6): the covenant cannot bite on a pre-commencement original grant date) and the encoding was corrected (F5). Dates are computed as the Act words them, with no working-day rule. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: Term under seven years: ends before the last day of the seven years beginning with the grant; s 13(2) rules; periodic counts as under.
forks.F2: s 13(1ZC) excludes even if s 13(2)(b) applies.
forks.F3: s 9B(4): bites the day after the 12 months beginning with the commencement date.
forks.F4: s 9A(1)(a): grant date used (term start not an input).
forks.F5: s 9B(6): renewal date entered as the grant; original earlier grant gives NOTHING.
forks.F6: s 20B: barred if served after the 18 months beginning with incurral, unless notified within them.
forks.F7: s 20 cap per item; one item per set of works.
forks.F8: s 3(1): two months end on the corresponding date.
forks.F9: s 3(3B): liability ends on the day of the first notice.
forks.F10: s 22: corresponding-date reading of 'within six months' and 'one month after'.
